sentences.text: Ms. Ragini Juneja, Advocate for R  CORAM:

ORDER % 03.09.2025 CRL.M.A. 26289/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. The petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No.482/2021 of PS Palam Village for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has settled all disputes with the petitioners.
3. Counsel for petitioners and counsel for respondent no.2 have appeared through videoconferencing.
But none of the private parties have appeared.
